rows.grounds: compound of lalāṭa forehead, varṇa syllable, rāśi mass, and stha situated; accusative singular neuter adjective
numeral lakṣa in accusative singular neuter
absolutive of kṛ to do, indicating completed action
compound of sura god and arcite worshipped; locative singular masculine adjective

items.question: What must be accomplished in the forehead syllable mass before divine worship?
premises: lalāṭa varṇa rāśi sthaṃ names the locus
items.inference: The verse prescribes completing a hundred thousand repetitions in the forehead syllable mass for divine worship.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of lakṣaṃ is not specified in this excerpt.
items.plain_english: Having done a hundred thousand in the forehead syllable mass, it is worshipped by gods.
